name: How does City Dweller, LLC ensure quality control for plumbing sub-trades?

mainEntity.name: How does City Dweller, LLC ensure quality control for plumbing sub-trades?

acceptedAnswer.text: City Dweller, LLC ensures quality control for plumbing sub-trades through several steps. We vet our plumbing partners to ensure they are licensed, insured, and have a proven track record. During construction, our project managers conduct regular site visits and inspections, verifying that installations adhere to approved plans, specifications, and local codes. We also coordinate required municipal inspections at critical stages to ensure compliance and address any deficiencies promptly, maintaining high standards for all plumbing work.
acceptedAnswer.description: We ensure quality by vetting licensed partners, conducting regular site inspections, verifying adherence to plans and codes, and coordinating municipal inspections.
